authority: Root review on 20 October 2026 of final-statistics, E4 and window interpretations; subsequent implementation may not change these rules after outcomes are loaded.
scope: A1-A4/A7 final hypothesis and coverage evaluation; root owns A5 measurement and the A6 owner supplies independently gated predictor results.

bootstrap.unit: Whole independent seed; all measurements from one seed retain their joint bootstrap weight.
bootstrap.sizes_and_models: Independent seed resampling across sizes and models unless exact paired identities are explicitly present.
bootstrap.E1: Identical whole-seed weights across exact latent-Gaussian sigma pairs.
bootstrap.frames: Time frames contribute a seed-level time average or distribution, never independent uncertainty replicates.

coverage.evaluable: Both compared sizes have empirical persistence resolved or bounded, and coverage at the crossing bracket or censoring lag is at least0.5.
coverage.undefined_heading: Low contrast or missing heading coverage does not invent a finite persistence upper bound. Strong-input persistence criterion stays inconclusive.
coverage.missing_work: Missing expected conditions, failed native/control/source gates and unavailable observation arms are not censoring.

forced.primary: Exclude a comparison if either relevant size is forced under the separately retained matched-mean and reviewed additional E1 flags. Required but missing flags leave primary qualification unavailable.
forced.sensitivity: Report forced-inclusive decisions alongside primary decisions.
forced.untested_E1_strengths: Additional E1 flag is not applicable outside its preselected fixed-mean grid; matched-mean flag remains required.

H1.model: Persistence-ratio95% CI lies strictly above1 at every evaluable input, no evaluable ratio CI lies below1, and largest-cell fhalf CI lies above and does not overlap the smallest-cell fhalf CI.
H1.overall: At least3 of4 models pass all required model criteria.
H1.weak_baseline: The actual weakest noisy input0.0001 remains the tolerance baseline. Censored/unavailable baselines stay bounded/inconclusive, never replaced by a stronger input.
H1.no_vacuous_pass: No evaluable input gives an inconclusive gain criterion. An unidentified ratio[0,infinity] cannot establish a gain.

H2.model: Either an evaluable persistence-ratio CI lies strictly below1; or the ratio drops at least2fold from an earlier peak to a later CI including1 while large-cell multiple-front fraction is strictly above0.5 at every designed input over that qualified range.
H2.peak_drop: Use resolved point ratios, or a drop certified by finite observation bounds. Report bootstrap uncertainty; do not impose an additional unrequested drop-CI threshold.
H2.overall: At least2 models meet the model criterion AND the frozen A6 primary direct-tau predictor gate passes.
H2.A6_gate: At least one predeclared primary predictor (multiple_front_fraction or region_count_mean) has pooled Spearman<=-0.6 and successful negative training and held-out associations in at least3 of4 planned model folds. Missing folds are not successes. Proxies and exploratory features cannot rescue this gate.
H2.E0_Holmes: The E0 main-view provisional peak-drop result cannot be promoted without the final common/long/window qualifications.

H3.strong_input: At largest size, an observed f greater than the weakest input meets tauStrong_upper <0.5*tauWeak_lower, using empirical observation bounds. Required coverage and forced qualifications apply.
H3.uncertainty_qualifier: Also report the same inequality using95% whole-seed CI bounds. This is a visible uncertainty qualifier, not a hidden extra hard gate.
H3.model_mode: The strong-input largest-cell A4 majority is multiple_fronts or low_contrast. Evaluate every designed input and retain all qualifying/nonqualifying rows.
H3.distinct_modes: Overall requires different abnormal modes in at least two different models. Two modes within one model do not suffice.
H3.E1_corroboration: At identical f/C, the sigma-one abnormal majority occurs at at least one other observed positive sigma from the complete predeclared grid{0.25,0.5,2}. Evaluate this explicit existence rule over all three sigmas and report each; no selected best-sigma display. Primary corroboration must be non-forced under the reviewed flags.
H3.fingerprints: Both region-count and basal-normalized-contrast fingerprints separate the distinct-mode model pair through non-overlapping95% whole-seed bootstrap CIs of dimensionless within-model largest/smallest effects.
H3.fingerprint_seed_summaries: Each seed contributes a time-weighted mean observed optical region count and time-weighted mean optical contrast divided by that exact optically processed basal contrast, using the root-approved common imaging cadence/kernel/contour. Retain seed-level distributions as supporting data.
H3.zero_denominators: Unavailable; no pseudocount, dropped bootstrap draw or artificial finite size effect.
H3.cross_model: Only dimensionless within-model size effects enter cross-model comparisons; no cross-model native times or physical scales.

arms.common: E2-augmented-E0 metrics at original sizes plus only genuinely new E3 sizes(C30/C50; Spring1.5/2.5), all at the original horizon. All E3 references remain checks; do not duplicate them or lose the E2 dense input grid.
arms.longest: A separate predeclared longest-qualified-arm decision table. Every one of the52 selected E4 conditions uses its completed long arm regardless of response; unselected conditions retain their sole common arm with that reason explicit.
arms.qualification: Exact source/control/native gates, exact Gaussian prefix and declared ODE-equivalence full scalar/profile/coupled-state prefix checks for available original seeds. New outer-grid seeds are explicit top-ups.
arms.no_pooling: No mixture of short and long time tracks within an estimator; no silent fallback when a preselected E4 arm or required gate is missing/failed. A completed long arm with undefined tau remains undefined.
arms.new_and_old_seeds: Report original-prefix and top-up populations; all12-seed long-arm results plus exact available original-seed sensitivity are retained.
arms.observation_time: Keep actual observation horizon, first-half discard, physical analysis windows and total forcing time visible.

A7.incompatibility: Disjoint95% empirical persistence intervals, including censoring bounds, or any A4 label change including loss of a majority to mixed, marks window_sensitive. Missing required views or coverage yields window_qualification_inconclusive.
A7.mobility: Dtheta CI incompatibility is reported separately; it cannot replace empirical persistence.
A7.horizon: Use the same interval/label comparison between common and long arms; incompatible results are horizon_sensitive. Keep early/late and original-prefix checks.
A7.robust_support: Distinguish robust-common+long support from qualified long-horizon-only support. Common-horizon inconclusiveness caused solely by censoring is not contrary evidence and cannot automatically veto otherwise qualified long-arm support.
A7.unqualified_headline: Requires support in both common and long tables where evaluable, with compatible evaluable windows/cadences. Missing checks cannot be counted as passes.
A7.long_only: A criterion newly established by E4 while the common arm was only censored is explicitly long-horizon-qualified, not rejected merely because E0 fhalf was unavailable.
A7.no_hidden_gate: Actual framing follows the complete criterion table, coverage and sensitivity labels; no further implicit hard gate is added.
